## Intraday Volume Estimator

Replication and cross-asset extension of a probabilistic Transformer model
for intraday volume forecasting.

**Markets:** U.S. equities and G10 foreign exchange  
**Methods:** Transformer, Student-t likelihood, multi-step training  
**Tools:** Python, PyTorch, LSEG data

## Nonlinear Time Series and Attention

Theoretical and empirical investigation of the conditions under which
softmax attention can outperform linear prediction in nonlinear
autoregressive models.

**Topics:** approximation error, estimation complexity, attention search
cost, statistical crossover thresholds

## Statistical Computing

Projects in statistical modelling, data analysis, SQL, Python, R, and
reproducible scientific publishing with Quarto.
